summary: Rockingham County summit that the Forest Lookouts site lists as a Virginia lookout. The USFS road and DWR page describe the summit; no source describes a tower.

access.note: The DWR page lists the access requirement as free and daily. Forest Road 85 is remote, rocky and deeply rutted, and only experienced off-road drivers should attempt it.

visit.trail_note: Forest Road 85 runs 3.6 miles to the summit. The DWR page suggests parking at Briery Branch Gap and walking or biking the 7.2-mile round trip.

notes_for_editor: The record's kind 'tower' is not supported by any text. The Forest Lookouts page has only a header (VIRGINIA LOOKOUTS, FLAGPOLE KNOB, Rockingham County) and one photo with no caption or credit, so the photo is not added. Neither the FFLOS Virginia list nor the NHLR Virginia list includes Flagpole Knob, and two searches found no build date, height, staffing or fire history. The DWR physical coordinates (38.510096, -79.183964) agree with the record's location to about 0.0001 degrees. The DWR gives the elevation as 4190 ft (about 1,277 m); the record's elevation_m is null and could take that value. Kind and status should stay unknown until a source describes a structure.
